title: Behaviours of the reference system that this application does not copy, or copies only in part, each with what it does instead. None counts as a match unless it says exact

overpayment.note: A payment of 300 on an invoice of 230: the journal holds the whole 300 and the invoice shows paid in excess

locks.note: The fields of an issued invoice, a credit note and a returned invoice are locked

delete_invoice.note: Deleting an issued invoice is refused: it is corrected by a credit note or a returned invoice

delete_payment.note: Deleting a payment deletes its journal and leaves the invoice unpaid

payment_statuses.note: A payment has five statuses and only the completed one has a journal

credit_applied.note: A new invoice of a customer with credit is settled from it at once, without journals

expected.why: the register gives the change back, so the journal holds what was kept

expected.result: allowed with the permission to delete sales, by reversing every journal and giving the stock back
expected.why: pending the owner's decision on locking issued invoices

remove a payment of 300 from an invoice

expected.why: a posted journal is never deleted (E15)

inputs.action: set a payment to review, failed or draft

expected.why: payment statuses arrive with the payment documents (P5)

inputs.action: issue an invoice to a customer who has credit

reference.settled: from the credit at once, without journals

expected.settled: no, the invoice stays open and the credit stays on the customer
